title: Herbie Website Starter
tagline: A complete small website with a blog, themes and search — ready in minutes.
description: A starter website for Herbie CMS with example pages, a blog, selectable themes, contact form and search.

themeDescriptions.default: Light baseline with the shared layouts and styles.
themeDescriptions.dark: Dark palette made from a single colour token file.
themeDescriptions.journal: Serif reading column with hairline rules and editorial details.
themeDescriptions.spotlight: Magazine-style cover hero and card grid.
themeDescriptions.docs: Documentation shell with a top bar and fixed side navigation.
themeDescriptions.portfolio: Dark project gallery with its own home grid.
themeDescriptions.high-contrast: White and yellow on black, strong borders and focus rings.
